title: Hemodynamic Monitoring Carotid Surgery
official: Effect of a Predictive Hemodynamic Approach on the Stump Pressure During Carotid Endoartectomy: a Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: patients scheduled for carotid endoarterectomy will be randomly assigned to a group in which arterial hypotension will be avoided by a predictive haemodynamic approach or to a group in which arterial hypotension will be treated in a standard manner
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- \>18 years old patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body MassIndex \> 35 Kg /m2;
* Atrial Fibrillation
* Urgent surgery
* Pregnancy
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
